justifications.read_only_justification: Returns only whether this connection is authenticated and which Ridian scopes it holds.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads nothing outside the current connection's own token.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads draft content, recipients and revision.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only an authorized Ridian mailbox draft; no recipient is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit or send the draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads queued/sending/final state, optionally waiting for status; does not initiate or retry delivery.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the existing send record in an authorized Ridian mailbox.
justifications.destructive_justification: No changes to the send job or message.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads stored message content and attachment metadata without marking read.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the authorized Ridian thread; remote images/active HTML are removed and links are not fetched.
justifications.destructive_justification: No message, folder or read-state changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns an opaque profile id and the display name and sign-in email of the connected Ridian account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the signed-in Ridian profile; no calendar, task, contact or mail data and no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot change or remove anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists attachment metadata for a permitted draft or message; no file transfer or write.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only attachments already in the authorized mailbox.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reads metadata without modifying files or messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a paginated list of saved drafts; never sends mail.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only stored drafts in an authorized Ridian mailbox.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit or delete drafts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a paginated thread list without marking messages read.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only a permitted Ridian mailbox and selected folder.
justifications.destructive_justification: No thread or read-state changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the client-selected Ridian mailboxes and current creation allowance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the signed-in person’s workspace mailboxes and allowance; no Google/Microsoft inbox access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create mailboxes or change mailbox state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new stored reply/forward draft and may copy selected attachments. It never sends.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only a permitted Ridian mailbox and messages/attachments already belonging to it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new draft without overwriting the source message or an existing draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a mailbox address after policy, quota and rate-limit checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only Ridian’s configured mailbox domain within the user’s workspace; no mail is sent.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new mailbox without replacing an existing one.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes one of the user's own Agent Mailboxes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the user's own mailbox in Ridian; no mail is sent and no outside system is changed.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the mailbox, its messages, drafts and attachments; the address cannot be reused. The full address must be passed as confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a saved draft and its attachments after revision validation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the permitted Ridian draft; queued/sent mail is excluded.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes draft content and attachments; no recall of sent messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Permanently deletes a thread from trash after validating the observed sequence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the authorized Ridian mailbox thread.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the thread and eligible stored content; trash and sequence preconditions do not remove the destructive effect.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and stores a one-use download ticket. This is a mutation, requires inbox:write and checks attachment read access.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only an existing authorized attachment and a short-lived authenticated Ridian download endpoint. No arbitrary destination or URL fetch.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a ticket without changing attachment bytes or messages. Expired-ticket cleanup removes only expired transfer credentials, not usable user content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sets the thread folder to inbox, archive or trash.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only a thread in the permitted Ridian mailbox.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites folder state and can move to trash. Restore support does not justify false.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a draft attachment after revision validation and releases its storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the selected authorized draft attachment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes stored bytes and cancels unfinished attachment work; cannot remove sent attachments.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or replaces a stored draft. Editing requires the latest expectedRevision.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only a permitted Ridian draft; recipient addresses are stored but no mail is sent.
justifications.destructive_justification: Editing replaces subject, recipient arrays and body without keeping the previous content. All modes share true even though creation alone is additive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists user-requested feedback and queues support delivery; requires feedback:write.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends to the fixed Ridian support inbox outside the user’s private workspace, including internal user/workspace routing references.
justifications.destructive_justification: Delivery cannot be recalled. A stable requestId prevents another feedback record but does not reverse sending.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues sending of the exact saved draft under send policy and limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends to explicitly supplied external To/CC/BCC recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Delivered email cannot be recalled. Revision and idempotency safeguards reduce mistakes but do not reverse delivery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores and queues a new message for delivery under send policy and limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends to explicitly supplied external To/CC/BCC recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Delivered email cannot be recalled; requestId prevents duplicate enqueueing, not irreversible delivery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes the thread’s read cursor or explicit unread state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only the authorized Ridian mailbox thread.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the existing read/unread state. Repeating the same state safely does not make the write additive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reserves an attachment/upload slot and stores a one-use upload ticket; bytes are uploaded separately.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only a draft in the permitted Ridian mailbox and Ridian’s authenticated upload endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new attachment reservation; does not overwrite an existing attachment or send mail.
